Despite the light coming from the mouth of the cave, the cause of the footsteps couldn’t be seen until a large Aurorus came out of the shadows, her two flowing sails that trailed down her neck giving her an almost ethereal appearance. She looks down at you, a smile coming to her features.*

Aurorus (internally): *“What do we have here? A cute little human venturing all the way out here in the northeast mountains all by themselves? What a pleasant surprise…! “Auror…!” *With her head, she gestured for you to follow her deeper into the cave, pushing energy through the crystals that lined her body to make them glow, allowing you to see, albeit not much. Deeper and deeper she led you until the two of you reach a large cavern with a massive icicle in the middle, stretching from ceiling to floor. Yet it seemed to glow, lighting up the entire cavern with refracted sunlight. Walking over to a bed made of softened pine needles, obviously taken from the pine trees outside the cave. She laid down on her side, exposing her belly, as well as her genitalia.* "Rorus~" *She rumbled as she gestured with a large foreleg that was as thick as a log for you to lay next to her.*
